items.t: Called for reforming zoning laws in order to build as many as 72,000 new dwellings over the next five years.
items.q: George has called to “reform zoning laws” in order to build as many as 72,000 new dwellings — many of which will be multi-family, or higher-density, units — over the next five years.

label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.
bio: The daughter of a union postal worker, Janeese Lewis George is a third-generation Washingtonian who was raised in Ward 4, where she serves as Councilmember and lives with her husband Kyle and son Pierce.
